node.subject: english
node.name: 识别转折与因果方向
node.definition: 区分转折、让步、原因与结果，准确复述命题指向。

lesson.definition: 区分转折、让步、原因与结果，准确复述命题指向。
lesson.foundation: because 引出原因，therefore 指向结果，however 连接反向或限制性信息。although 引出让步背景。
lesson.principle: 连接词规定命题关系。A because B 表 B 解释 A；Although B, A 表承认 B，同时给出预期之外的 A。
lesson.approach: 先把两句分别复述，再画原因到结果的方向。没有显式标记时同时核对句义。

examples.prompt: Mina missed the bus because the meeting ran late. 原因是什么？
examples.solution: 会议延时导致错过公交，because 后是原因。

examples.prompt: Although the trial was short, the team detected a clear pattern. 强调什么？
examples.solution: 尽管试验时间短，团队仍找到明显模式。主要陈述在逗号后。

lesson.error: 见到 however 就认为后句完全否定前句。先判断后句是反对，还是补充限制。
lesson.standard: 能说明标记词连接的两条命题及其关系，并维持因果方向。
lesson.application: 段落主旨题常在转折后呈现作者关注点，再结合现有段落范围核对。

questions.prompt: The gate was closed, so we took a longer route. 原因是什么？
questions.explanation: so 前是原因，后是结果。

questions.prompt: Although the tank was small, it stored enough water. 主陈述？
questions.explanation: 让步从句给背景，主句说水够。

questions.prompt: The app works offline. However, maps must be downloaded first. 第二句作用？
questions.explanation: 离线可用同时要求预先下载。

questions.prompt: The field was flooded because the drain was blocked. 何者导致何者？
The sample was small; therefore, the estimates were uncertain. therefore 表？
questions.explanation: 样本较小带来估计不确定。
